svg.title: HeatmapVLN slow-to-fast navigation architecture
svg.desc: A code-faithful overview of panoramic System-2 reasoning, the trainable latent bridge, frozen System-1 diffusion control, and the auxiliary heatmap pretraining branch.
svg.text: First pass: structured waypoint · Second pass: four contextual latent states
frozen visual memory + diffusion trajectory prior
depth + intrinsics → GT · relative pose PE → attention
